Pitch Smart daily maximums and rest requirements

Source: R/pitch_smart_rules.R
pitch_smart_rules.Rd

The MLB/USA Baseball Pitch Smart guidelines for ages 7 to 18, in long form: one row per age group and pitch-count band. Used by check_pitch_counts().

Usage

pitch_smart_rules

Format

A data frame with 28 rows and 6 integer columns:

age_min, age_max

Age group, inclusive.

daily_max

Most pitches allowed in one day for the age group.

pitches_min, pitches_max

Pitch-count band, inclusive.

rest_days

Calendar days of rest required after a day in the band.

Source

Major League Baseball and USA Baseball. n.d. "Pitching Guidelines." Pitch Smart. Accessed November 26, 2026. https://www.mlb.com/pitch-smart/pitching-guidelines. Built by data-raw/pitch-smart.R.

Details

Ages 19 to 22 are omitted because the published rest table stops at 105 pitches while their daily maximum is 120. Many state associations and leagues set their own limits; edit a copy of this table and pass it to check_pitch_counts() to use them.

Examples

pitch_smart_rules[pitch_smart_rules$age_min == 11, ]
#>    age_min age_max daily_max pitches_min pitches_max rest_days
#> 9       11      12        85           1          20         0
#> 10      11      12        85          21          35         1
#> 11      11      12        85          36          50         2
#> 12      11      12        85          51          65         3
#> 13      11      12        85          66          85         4
